## What was built
A new molecule at `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmCartItemActions/`: `index.tsx` (component `ZimmCartItemActions`), `index.test.tsx`, `index.stories.tsx`, `zimmCartItemActions.css.ts` (recipe), plus a co-located hook `usePendingWishlistItem.ts` + `usePendingWishlistItem.test.ts`. It renders "Remove" / "Move to Wishlist" text links below a cart line's quantity stepper (SFCC-270 AC8 / SFCC-272). Read all 6 files yourself first, in full — they're short.

## Two architecture corrections to independently verify (do not take my word, or the Implementer's own comments, at face value — verify against the actual other files cited)

**Correction 1: `ZimmCartItemActions` must NOT call `useWishlistAuthDrawer` itself.** It renders once per cart line (supplied via `product-item`'s own `secondaryActions` prop), while the whole cart needs exactly ONE `useWishlistAuthDrawer` instance (a direct per-row call would mount N instances in an N-item cart). Verify:
- `grep -rn "useWishlistAuthDrawer" overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmCartItemActions/` returns nothing (except possibly in a comment referencing it, which is fine — check whether any hit is a real call or just prose).
- `ZimmCartItemActionsProps` (in `index.tsx`) has `isGuest: boolean` and `onGuestWishlistClick: () => void` as plain props, not derived from a hook call inside the component.
- Read `overrides/app/components/product-item/index.tsx` and confirm `secondaryActions` is declared as a prop (search for the exact string `secondaryActions`) at roughly the props-type declaration, the destructuring, and the render call — cite the real line numbers you find (they should be near lines 176, 257, 365, but verify yourself rather than assume).
- Read `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmerMANN-skills/.runs/SFCC-11/plan.md` and search for the string "Clarified 2026-09-20, found by this step's own Implementer" — confirm it exists in the step 4.4 section and accurately describes this same correction (i.e. the plan's own text was updated to match what was actually built, not left stale).

**Correction 2: no direct SDK/basket mutation calls from this component.** The actual `removeItemFromBasket`/wishlist-add SDK calls are meant to arrive as callback props (`onRemove`, `onMoveToWishlist`), matching an existing precedent: `product-item/index.tsx`'s own `onItemQuantityChange?: (quantity: number) => any` prop (grep to confirm this prop really exists in that file, cite the line). Verify:
- `grep -rn "commerce-sdk-react\|useShopperBasketsMutation\|useShopperBasketsV2Mutation\|useCurrentBasket" overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmCartItemActions/index.tsx overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmCartItemActions/usePendingWishlistItem.ts` returns nothing (test files are allowed to reference these in mocks — only check the two real source files).

## A disclosed, deliberately-not-fixed-here gap to confirm is handled correctly (do not re-litigate whether it's real — it is; only check it was disclosed correctly and not silently "solved")

Read `overrides/app/hooks/useWishlistAuthDrawer.ts` lines ~163-259 yourself. Confirm that inside the `useEffect(..., [isRegistered])` block, `onAuthSuccess?.()` is called BEFORE `mergeBasket.mutate(...)` in source order (i.e. the auth-success signal fires synchronously, before the merge mutation even starts, let alone resolves). This means a resume wired straight to `onAuthSuccess` could act on a not-yet-merged, not-yet-capped basket.

Now read every comment and every line of logic in `zimmCartItemActions/index.tsx` and `usePendingWishlistItem.ts`. Confirm:
- Neither file contains a comment or code path that asserts or implies the resume is safe from racing an unsettled merge/cap chain (that would be a false guarantee — a 🔴 finding if found).
- Neither file attempts to actually solve the ordering problem itself (e.g. no artificial delay, no polling on merge/cap state, no import of `useCartMergeAndCap`) — that responsibility belongs to `cartDrawerContainer.tsx` (SFCC-11 plan step 4.6, not built yet), which this step correctly has no visibility into.
- Report the exact quote of whatever comment(s) in this step's files DO address this topic, and judge whether the framing is honest (defers to the caller) vs. overclaiming.

## The plan's 10 pass criteria — verify each with evidence

Read `#### Step 4.4 — ZimmCartItemActions + pending-item-across-auth` in full at `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmerMANN-skills/.runs/SFCC-11/plan.md` (search for that heading) for the complete, current text and its "Pass criteria" list (11 items, the 11th about merge/cap ordering already covered above). For each of criteria 1-10, find the specific test (in `index.test.tsx` or `usePendingWishlistItem.test.ts`) that proves it, and run it for real:

```
npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmCartItemActions --reporter=verbose
```//(check package.json first for the actual correct vitest invocation for this repo if this doesn't work as-is)

Cite the exact test name that proves each criterion. Pay special attention to pass criterion 9 ("Resume from React state (same-instance re-render) and resume from session storage (fresh mount, no prior state) both work — check these are two genuinely distinct test scenarios, not the same scenario asserted twice.") — quote the two specific test names and confirm they exercise genuinely different code paths (one via `rerender()` on a mounted instance, one via a fresh `renderHook()`/`render()` call with no prior render).

## Mutation-test at least two things yourself (falsify, don't just read)

1. In `zimmCartItemActions/index.tsx`, temporarily break `attemptMoveToWishlist` (e.g. comment out the `notifyAddedToWishlist(productName)` call, or swap the order so `onRemove()` is never awaited). Re-run the relevant test(s) and confirm they FAIL with the mutation in place. Then revert your edit exactly and re-run to confirm they pass again. Show both outputs.
2. In `usePendingWishlistItem.ts`, temporarily break the 5-minute freshness check (e.g. change `<=` to a condition that would let a stale item through, or invert `isFresh`). Re-run `usePendingWishlistItem.test.ts` and confirm the "older than 5 minutes" tests FAIL with the mutation in place. Then revert exactly and confirm they pass again. Show both outputs.
Confirm via `git diff overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmCartItemActions/` at the very end that there is ZERO net change from your mutation testing.

## A few specific claims to verify yourself, not trust

- `ZimmLink` at `size="small"` — read `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmLink/zimmLink.css.ts` and confirm `sizes.sm` sets `textTransform: 'capitalize'`, and `baseStyle` sets `paddingBlock: 'var(--zimm-scale-2xs)'` (a vertical-padding value). Confirm `--zimm-scale-2xs` resolves to `0.25rem` (4px) via `overrides/app/theme/foundation/spacing.ts`.
- Read `overrides/app/theme/foundation/colour.ts` and confirm `link.default` and `text.default` both resolve to `grey[900]` (same primitive reference, not just the same hex typed twice).
- Confirm `ZimmLink`'s recipe has a real `_hover` and `_focusVisible` but genuinely no `_active` key anywhere in `zimmLink.css.ts`. Then check `zimmCartItemActions/index.test.tsx` does NOT contain any assertion referencing an `_active` state as if it were real (grep for `_active` in that test file — it should return nothing, or if it does, evaluate whether it's a fabricated/false claim).
- Read `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmWishlistAuthDrawer/index.tsx` lines 35-58 (the file cited inside `zimmCartItemActions/index.tsx`'s own architecture-note docblock as "the existing precedent" for calling `useWishlistAuthDrawer` from a `ui-kits/` component). Confirm that citation is accurate — does that file genuinely call `useWishlistAuthDrawer` from within a presentational `ui-kits/` component?
- Pass criterion 6 is claimed to also satisfy a previously-deferred Storybook-portal proof from an earlier committed step (SFCC-272's `useCartMessages`, which had no renderable component to prove a `within(document.body)` toast-portal assertion against). Check `index.stories.tsx`'s `WishlistMoveSuccess` story's `play` function: does it genuinely query `within(document.body)` for the toast content, with an inline comment citing the portal exception from `.claude/rules/testing.md`? Quote the relevant lines.
